title: Trickery Chicago Magic Show
includes: Cups and bottle openers are available for guests to use.
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Intended for enjoyment of adults. Not recommended for guests younger than 12 years of age.
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Chicago’s most entertaining magic show! Fun, intimate, sometimes outrageous, and always hilarious.

Theater is located at 3453 N Halsted Street (near the SE corner of Cornelia Ave). Door opens 15 minutes before showtime and seating is general admission. 

Venue is BYOB for guests 21+. Cups and bottle openers are available if needed. We do not stock ice but there is a 7-Eleven just down the street (3407 N Halsted). Performance runs approximately 1 hour.
